Oh dear Sibylares, I apologize.\nThey didn't mean to make such a fuss.\nPlease accept my humble apologies.
The spooky trick just went a lil' outta control.\nPlease forgive them!
Forgive me, pom~!
I'm sorry for bothering you while you're resting~.
Aaaaaah! Another ghost!!
It's because you went on a rampage and destroyed\nSibylares' place to sleep, you know!\nYou should apologize properly!!
This is a dream, a bad dreammm...U-um, I l-l-lost\ncontrol of myself and I accidentally destroyed a\nb-building? or a tomb? I-I-I'm sorry~.
Phew~...
I thought something terrible was gonna happen...
Hey, you were supposed to be the one who scares\npeople, how could you just freak out like that...

That's because no one ever told me that there\nwould be real ghosts!
Well, well since the guest have experienced all of\nthe tricks, let's have the guest decide which\ntrick was the most surprising one!
First, let's all go back to Tir Na Nog Square!

I-i-i-it's here againnn!!
Oh well, don't panic! Sibylares just showed up\nwhile we were working on our trick.
Sibylares has one request, so you're here at the\nright time...
I-I'm sorry for what happened the other day...\nI got mad because the mausoleum was destroyed,\nthat was embarrassing...
I fought you as I couldn't control my anger and\nended up losing without being able to discern your\nstrength. It kinda bothers me...
I've also heard from these three that you're\npretty great, so I'd like to have a duel with you\nonce again...What do you say?
I-i-i-if that's the case, t-t-t-this adventurer\nwill be your opponent~!
That was wonderful! I've never had such an awesome\nbattle even when I was alive.\nThank you for having a duel with me!

Okay!
